citations.claim: first violating step: total energy jumped to -86.1 from E0 -69.2
one step earlier energy was still near E0, showing sudden jump at close approach
violating pair body 1 moving at speed 8.28 during deep close encounter distance 0.14

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.02932 to 0.005 with all else identical; finer timestep resolves the close encounter and removes the energy jump

explanation: Bodies 1 (m=6.75) and 4 (m=15.69) fall into a deep close encounter (distance 0.33 at step 8 shrinking to 0.14 at step 9, below softening 0.3). Acceleration and velocity spike (body 1 speed 6.6->8.28). The integrator uses fixed dt=0.0293 with only 6 substeps_in_step at steps 8 and 9, so the rapidly varying strong force during periapsis is under-resolved by leapfrog, causing a sudden non-physical energy jump from -68.9 to -86.1 exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt alone removes the violation.
vision_note: Two blue bodies on the upper-left converge and overlap into a single merged blob by steps 8 to 9 with small velocity ticks visible. The other bodies to the lower-middle and far-right stay well separated and show no large motion.
